messages:
cs-rep-oliver: Customer reported embed API p99 jump ~3x since 2026-03-16 21:45 UTC. They saw timeouts and elevated token billing. Attaching sample request IDs.
maria-eng: Confirming cluster-wide p99 bump for embed workers in eu-west-2 starting ~21:40 UTC. QPS roughly flat. CPU fine, but host iowait and nvme qdepth spiked.
sre-oncall-jess: Alert fired: embed-p99 > 800ms for 10m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/example/alerts/938765 (charts show p95/p99 divergence)
infra-eng-kevin: We rolled CUDA driver 12.3 -> nodes in dedicated pool eu-west-2 between 21:30-21:40 as part of batch rollout. Could match timeline.
maria-eng: Correlation: NVMe avg await jumped from ~1ms to 12-20ms on affected hosts. KV cache miss ratio didn't change much.
sre-oncall-jess: Can someone cordon a node and capture iostat/blktrace + kernel logs? I'll coordinate.
infra-eng-kevin: Cordoned node rwd-12. iostat snapshot:
```
Device: nvme0n1
r/s   w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s await
12.3  8.1  6144   2048  15.2
```
blktrace shows long queue bursts.
eng-runtime-zoe: Runtime logs show repeated GPU DMA timeout entries and driver resets interleaved with hostfs stalls:
```
[drm] DMA timeout on GPU0 -> driver reset
nvme: qdepth full, hw timeout
```
platform-matt: Temporarily routed embed traffic for the impacted customer to smaller model variant and failed-over requests to another region. Also applied a soft rate-limit for large-batch embedding jobs.
cs-rep-oliver: Customer confirms fewer outright errors after fallback, but still p95 ~400ms on heavy payloads.
sre-oncall-jess: Short-term mitigation: rolling back driver on the dedicated pool to previous version (12.2) and evacuating heavy IO colocated tenants. Initiating rollback now.
infra-eng-kevin: Rollback started 21:54 UTC, completed on the pool by 22:06 UTC. Monitoring for recovery.
maria-eng: Post-rollback stats: nvme await down to ~1.3ms, kernel logs no further DMA reset patterns.
eng-runtime-zoe: After rollback, small payload latencies normalized. Long-seq embed p99 still ~200-250ms due to KV cache warmup and burst queueing; needs further tuning.
platform-matt: Proposed follow-ups: (1) add canary guardrail to driver rollouts, (2) add per-host IO qdisc to limit NVMe hogging by noisy tenants, (3) avoid colocating heavy embed/backup jobs with dedicated GPU pools via scheduler rules.
sre-oncall-jess: Opening incident: INC-2026-211 (postmortem ticket) assigned to infra-eng-kevin (driver rollouts), eng-runtime-zoe (kv warmup + backpressure), cs-rep-oliver (customer updates).
cs-rep-oliver: I'll send the customer a clear summary: rollback done, temporary fallbacks applied, follow-up timeline and credit offer. ETA for fix?
infra-eng-kevin: ETA: qdisc + basic canary automation in ~2 weeks. Driver pinning policy update pushed this week.
ops-bot: Incident annotated: severity=P2, start=2026-03-16T21:45:00Z, mitigated=2026-03-16T22:10:00Z :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall-jess: Repro notes I will attach to ticket: reproduce by rolling driver in a canary pool while running a synthetic embed workload plus NVMe stress (fio --rw=randrw --bs=128k --iodepth=32 --size=10G --numjobs=4). Capture iostat, dmesg, and runtime traces.
platform-matt: Also adding an automated traffic-fallback policy for model variants when p99 exceeds X ms for 5m to reduce customer impact.
cs-rep-oliver: Customer update sent. Marking as resolved for now; will reopen if we see recurrence.
